alt: 提著小提琴盒的女子來到廣場，人們興奮招手，手中拿著她演奏時的肖像畫。
scene_prompt: A widely recognized female violin virtuoso arrives at a town music courtyard carrying a violin case. Many diverse townspeople instantly recognize her, joyfully wave and show small portrait pictures of the same unmistakable woman holding a violin; the portraits have no lettering. Her face and hairstyle match all portraits. Excited familiar recognition, not thunder or ear effects.
